faqs.question: How do I view a property?
faqs.answer: Use Schedule a viewing to name the property and when suits you, and an agent confirms a time. Every listing also opens on Propertybook, where you can browse photos and details.

faqs.question: Can I finance a purchase through CBZ?
faqs.answer: Yes. CBZ Bank mortgages sit alongside our listings. The mortgage calculator on each property page gives an indicative monthly repayment before you apply.

faqs.question: Why do some listings show "price on application"?
faqs.answer: Prices, availability and specifications are confirmed when you enquire, so you always get the current figure rather than one that may have changed.

faqs.question: Do you offer virtual tours?
faqs.answer: On listings that have one, press Take a virtual tour on the listing page. The tour loads only when you ask for it.

faqs.question: Can I buy from the diaspora?
faqs.answer: Yes. Several developments are designed for buyers abroad, and the diaspora banking page explains how to open the account and mortgage from outside Zimbabwe.

productsNote: Prices, availability and specifications are confirmed on application.
about: CBZ Properties manages and develops the Group’s real estate interests, serving individuals, SMEs, corporates and institutions. Its mandate spans property development and project management, residential and commercial sales, leasing and property management, valuations and advisory, estate agency and facilities management. A purchase can be financed by a CBZ Bank mortgage and insured by CBZ Insurance.
